opening.argument: The presentation makes sweeping promises of success while pairing them with a recruitment-based earning structure. It declares that “we will all, all win” and claims that members have “doubled or even tripled their investments thanks to the marketing of OneCoin network,” portraying participation as a rapid path to financial freedom. It then describes creating teams of four, three, and five people, making clear that growth depends on building a network and earning through its commissions. The speaker also frames participation as “your personal and financial investment,” presents OneCoin as a secure income-generating currency, and directly urges viewers to join and contact him by email. These combined assurances, investment claims, team-building instructions, and signup direction establish the promoted recruitment scheme.
